facts.business: International Combustion (India) Limited operates through three business divisions: Heavy Engineering Division catering to steel, mining, mineral beneficiation and material handling industries; Geared Motors & Industrial Gear Box Division; and Building Material Division focused on advanced dry mortar and related products.

segments.name: Geared Motors & Industrial Gear Box Division

guidance_or_targets.statement: The Company remains cautiously optimistic about future business prospects considering the expected recovery in infrastructure, industrial investments and increasing focus on domestic manufacturing initiatives and continued growth in the construction sector.
Heavy Engineering Division is expected to witness gradual improvement in demand driven by infrastructure development and revival in industrial activity.
Geared Motors & Industrial Gear Box Division expects steady growth supported by increasing industrial demand and expanding customer acceptance.
Building Material Division expects significant growth opportunities from the construction and infrastructure sectors.
